feature_queries.name: user_profile
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.user_id,
  e.timestamp,
  u.user_type,
  u.beer_rating_count AS user_beer_rating_count_lifetime,
  u.avg_beer_rating AS user_avg_beer_rating_lifetime,
  u.max_beer_rating AS user_max_beer_rating_lifetime,
  u.min_beer_rating AS user_min_beer_rating_lifetime,
  u.place_rating_count AS user_place_rating_count_lifetime,
  u.avg_place_rating AS user_avg_place_rating_lifetime,
  u.favorite_count AS user_favorite_count_lifetime,
  u.total_activity_count AS user_total_activity_count_lifetime,
  DATE_DIFF('day', u.created_at, e.timestamp) AS user_age_days_asof,
  DATE_DIFF('day', u.updated_at, e.timestamp) AS days_since_user_profile_update
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN users u
  ON e.user_id = u.user_id

feature_queries.name: beer_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH br AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.created_at,
    r.total_score,
    r.description_score
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings r
    ON r.user_id = e.user_id
   AND r.created_at < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(created_at) AS beer_ratings_cnt_all,
  AVG(total_score) AS beer_total_score_mean_all,
  STDDEV_SAMP(total_score) AS beer_total_score_std_all,
  AVG(description_score) AS beer_desc_score_mean_all,
  MAX(created_at) AS beer_last_rating_ts,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(created_at), timestamp) AS beer_days_since_last_rating,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_cnt_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_cnt_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_cnt_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_cnt_365d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN total_score ELSE NULL END) AS beer_total_score_mean_30d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN total_score ELSE NULL END) AS beer_total_score_mean_90d
FROM br
GROUP BY user_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: beer_diversity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.created_at,
    r.beer_id,
    b.style_id,
    b.brewer_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings r
    ON r.user_id = e.user_id
   AND r.created_at < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN beers b
    ON b.beer_id = r.beer_id
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT beer_id) AS distinct_beers_all,
  COUNT(DISTINCT brewer_id) AS distinct_brewers_all,
  COUNT(DISTINCT style_id) AS distinct_styles_all,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN beer_id ELSE NULL END) AS distinct_beers_90d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN brewer_id ELSE NULL END) AS distinct_brewers_90d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN style_id ELSE NULL END) AS distinct_styles_90d
FROM x
GROUP BY user_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: beer_lang
feature_queries.sql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.created_at,
    r.language
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings r
    ON r.user_id = e.user_id
   AND r.created_at < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  timestamp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND language = 'en' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lang_en_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND language = 'es' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lang_es_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND language = 'fr' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lang_fr_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND language = 'de' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lang_de_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND language = 'pt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lang_pt_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND language NOT IN ('en','es','fr','de','pt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lang_other_365d
FROM x
GROUP BY user_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: user_x_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    beer_rating_count AS lifetime_beer_cnt,
    total_activity_count AS lifetime_total_cnt
  FROM users
), br AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id,
    e.timestamp,
    COUNT(r.created_at) AS cnt_all,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', r.created_at, e.timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', r.created_at, e.timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_90d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', r.created_at, e.timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_365d,
    MAX(r.created_at) AS last_ts
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings r
    ON r.user_id = e.user_id
   AND r.created_at < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.user_id, e.timestamp
), j AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id,
    e.timestamp,
    COALESCE(u.lifetime_beer_cnt,0) AS lifetime_beer_cnt,
    COALESCE(u.lifetime_total_cnt,0) AS lifetime_total_cnt,
    COALESCE(br.cnt_30d,0) AS cnt_30d,
    COALESCE(br.cnt_90d,0) AS cnt_90d,
    COALESCE(br.cnt_365d,0) AS cnt_365d,
    br.last_ts,
    DATE_DIFF('day', br.last_ts, e.timestamp) AS days_since_last
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN u ON e.user_id=u.user_id
  LEFT JOIN br ON e.user_id=br.user_id AND e.timestamp=br.timestamp
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  timestamp,
  LOG(1 + lifetime_beer_cnt) AS log_lifetime_beer_cnt,
  LOG(1 + lifetime_total_cnt) AS log_lifetime_total_cnt,
  days_since_last,
  (days_since_last / (1.0 + LOG(1 + lifetime_beer_cnt))) AS days_since_last_over_log_lifetime,
  ((cnt_365d + 1.0) / (lifetime_beer_cnt + 1.0)) AS frac_lifetime_in_365d,
  ((cnt_30d + 1.0) / (cnt_365d + 1.0)) AS ratio_30d_to_365d_again,
  ((cnt_90d + 1.0) / (cnt_365d + 1.0)) AS ratio_90d_to_365d_again,
  (cnt_30d / (1.0 + LOG(1 + lifetime_beer_cnt))) AS cnt_30d_over_log_lifetime,
  (cnt_90d / (1.0 + LOG(1 + lifetime_beer_cnt))) AS cnt_90d_over_log_lifetime
FROM j

feature_queries.name: beer_burstiness
feature_queries.sql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id,
    e.timestamp,
    CAST(r.created_at AS DATE) AS d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings r
    ON r.user_id=e.user_id
   AND r.created_at < e.timestamp
), day_counts AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    timestamp,
    d,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM x
  WHERE d IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id, timestamp, d
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    timestamp,
    COUNT(*) AS active_days_all,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_days_30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_days_90d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_days_365d,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN cnt ELSE NULL END) AS max_ratings_in_a_day_90d,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 THEN cnt ELSE NULL END) AS max_ratings_in_a_day_365d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS total_ratings_90d_from_daycounts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS total_ratings_365d_from_daycounts
  FROM day_counts
  GROUP BY user_id, timestamp
)
SELECT
  e.user_id,
  e.timestamp,
  a.active_days_all,
  a.active_days_30d,
  a.active_days_90d,
  a.active_days_365d,
  a.max_ratings_in_a_day_90d,
  a.max_ratings_in_a_day_365d,
  (a.max_ratings_in_a_day_90d * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.total_ratings_90d_from_daycounts, 0)) AS top_day_frac_90d,
  (a.max_ratings_in_a_day_365d * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.total_ratings_365d_from_daycounts, 0)) AS top_day_frac_365d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN agg a
  ON e.user_id=a.user_id AND e.timestamp=a.timestamp

feature_queries.name: place_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH pr AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.created_at,
    r.total_score
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN place_ratings r
    ON r.user_id = e.user_id
   AND r.created_at < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(created_at) AS place_ratings_cnt_all,
  AVG(total_score) AS place_total_score_mean_all,
  MAX(created_at) AS place_last_rating_ts,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(created_at), timestamp) AS place_days_since_last_rating,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS place_ratings_cnt_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', created_at, timestamp) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS place_ratings_cnt_90d
FROM pr
GROUP BY user_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: time_context
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  user_id,
  timestamp,
  EXTRACT('dow' FROM timestamp) AS dow,
  EXTRACT('month' FROM timestamp) AS month,
  EXTRACT('year' FROM timestamp) AS year
FROM eval_table
